structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions
Licensure and Certification of Other Practitioners of the Healing Arts

law.catch_line: Advisory Board of Occupational Therapy; composition; appointment
law.text: The Advisory Board shall be comprised of five members appointed by the Governor for four-year terms. Three members shall be, at the time of appointment, licensed occupational therapists who have practiced for not less than three years, one member shall be a physician licensed to practice medicine in the Commonwealth, and one member shall be appointed by the Governor from the Commonwealth at large. Any vacancy occurring during a member's term shall be filled for the unexpired balance of that term.
